title: General short-stay arrival checklist for Kazakhstan citizens in China
content: Synthetic official-style record. For a short stay, keep passport, valid visa or visa-free eligibility proof when applicable, hotel booking, return ticket, and emergency contacts ready. Follow published entry, accommodation registration, and local public security requirements.

title: Student arrival and university registration guide
content: Synthetic official-style record. New students should confirm arrival dates with the university, prepare passport, admission documents, visa or residence-permit materials, accommodation details, and complete registration steps through the university international office.

title: Work-status caution guide
content: Synthetic official-style record. Work activity must match the person's lawful status and documents. Do not start paid work before confirming work authorization with the employer, local authorities, and the relevant official procedures.

title: Hospital visit preparation guide
content: Synthetic official-style record. For a hospital visit, prepare passport, insurance details if available, medication names, allergy information, payment method, and a Chinese description of symptoms. Serious symptoms require urgent medical care.

title: Lost passport emergency preparation guide
content: Synthetic official-style record. If a passport is lost, prepare identification copies, police loss report information, recent photos if requested, travel itinerary, and contact the relevant embassy or consulate for current emergency document instructions.

title: WeChat Pay and Alipay setup caution guide
content: Synthetic official-style record. Use official app flows for wallet setup, confirm identity and bank-card requirements, avoid sharing verification codes, and keep an alternate payment method while account review or card binding is pending.
